}}'''Willa Mandair''' was a woman and camp follower residing in Lord [[Ellisar|Ellisar's]] camp during the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Willa Mandair}}

==History==
Willa Mandair gives birth to a son, [[Bili Mandair|Bili]] in Lord Ellisar's camp. She gave birth on the day of [[Gitara Moroso]]'s [[foretelling]]. When [[Moiraine Damodred]] reads the name, she adds it to her book as a candidate for the [[Dragon Reborn]].{{ref/book|0|6}}
